complicacoes.texto: Klarion was born and raised in an underground faux-Puritanical settlement that practiced necromancy and had no contact with the surface world. As such, he is very out of place in normal social situations and misses many social cues.

Klarion has large, dark eyes, pointy ears, black lips and fingernails, and bluish- white skin, in addition, he dresses in Puritan-style garb, all of which makes him look very unusual. Klarion looks even more unusual when he assumes his Horigal form, which is horrible and horrific.
